scope: Source-recorded track synthesis; no fresh proof/experiment/literature audit

tracks.title: Early core and PXC search history
tracks.exact_claim: Early counterexample hunts developed exact rational search, whole-core reconstruction and fairness-selector diagnostics; later focused structural/asymptotic/assignment papers replaced many local candidate branches.
tracks.limits: The PXC archive and numerous finite certificates are research history, not additional completed papers. Absence of small counterexamples did not prove general claims.
tracks.status: historical/subsumed
tracks.evidence_class: archived exploration and retained certificates
tracks.remaining_work: Use P1-P9/current paper-specific audit before reviving an old search or paper count.

tracks.title: Hardware/local-energy/grid participation floor
tracks.exact_claim: For one local-energy owner, one grid-capacity owner and separate hardware owners, the stated public grand-marginal participation floor theta has sharp uniform total funding 1+theta/4.
tracks.limits: Specified ownership institution, public floor and production technology; not private-cost elicitation or measured energy savings. Mixed resource ownership requires separate analysis.
tracks.status: recorded theorem; supporting research
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof and exact scoped checks
tracks.remaining_work: Keep as a scoped corollary/institution; actual rights and economic value still need evidence.

tracks.title: Mixed-owner depth-two envelope
tracks.exact_claim: For F=min(H,P+sum_j min(H_j,L_j)), the actual individual own-report envelope has funding at most 323/200=1.615, uniformly over owners/branches. The accepted diffuse hardware-bottleneck asymptotic and response lemmas refine that same architecture. The same technology is the fractional resource graph with edges H_j--L_j and H_j--P; graph TCWM implies individual monotonicity with the same owners.
tracks.limits: Not optimal across mechanisms. A sub-8/5 proof covers the hardware bottleneck with normalized capped outer mass >=2 only; the other relaxation has a rational value >1.6, not an actual-game counterexample. The general S>=2 C^2 shortcut was withdrawn.
tracks.status: recorded theorem; earlier sub-two existence target superseded by graph 3/2
tracks.evidence_class: analytic reductions plus exact interval certificate
tracks.remaining_work: Human assessment of integrated contribution; no automatic deeper-forest campaign, because later graph theorem covers that existence goal.

tracks.title: Weighted resource graphs and arity two
tracks.exact_claim: Sharp TCWM total factor 3/2 on weighted fractional resource graphs; full OUT factor 2, sharp when full-owner deletion-marginal floors are imposed. Two-sparse divisible technologies admit same-owner positive graph lifts plus linear terms. Rational approximation gives 3/2+epsilon TCWM or 2+epsilon full OUT with exact incentives/coverage.
tracks.limits: Floor-free general full OUT remains [1+c,2], c approximately .5430633898. Graph lifts may be exponential. Positive binary-min representations are restricted; representation obstructions are not all-mechanism lower bounds.
tracks.status: recorded broad theorem; graph full-OUT frontier open
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof, source comparisons, exact checks
tracks.remaining_work: New general full-OUT construction or lower; current four-resource-path theorem is a specific advance, not an arbitrary-graph solution.

tracks.title: Partial outside protection and marginal floors
tracks.exact_claim: Recorded universal d-resource frontier K_d(beta,theta)=1+(d-1)max{mu(beta),theta}, with mu=1/2 up to beta0 approximately .9190487203 and mu(1)=c. Finite rational rules give exact full OUT with arbitrarily small additive funding overhead.
tracks.limits: Do not confuse partial outside coefficient beta, floor theta, total funding K, and external supplement K-1. This is coalition protection, not an unrestricted individual-only lower.
tracks.status: recorded supporting theorem; main endpoints consolidated in P9
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof and finite arithmetic checks
tracks.remaining_work: Integrate only coherent consequences; specialist priority check against established monotonic cost/production sharing.

tracks.title: Shared-capacity production and growing branches
tracks.exact_claim: For F=min(P,sum_{j<=M}min(a_j,b_j)), optimal TCWM/full-OUT funding order is Theta(M^(1/4)); fixed k private inputs per branch yield Theta_k(M^((k-1)/(2k))). Ownership/floor variants and heterogeneous-layer transfers are recorded.
tracks.limits: This does not solve arbitrary arity-three production. Older sqrt(log M), cube-root and s^(1/4) global lower headlines are superseded in their respective domains. Actual owner counts, common-cap owner count and floors change the model.
tracks.status: recorded structural theorem family
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof, exact certificates, internal review
tracks.remaining_work: Possible supporting structured-production consequences; no separate paper for each parameter or corollary.

tracks.title: Reserve cones and norm geometry
tracks.exact_claim: F(t,x)=t-||x|| on its feasible cone has sharp 3/2 TCWM and 1+c full OUT when the finite-dimensional norm is linearly isometric to an L1 subspace. Includes Euclidean norms and stated ell_p classes. For p>=2 separate bounds p and p/a_p and growing-p lower results are recorded.
tracks.limits: Retained and withdrawn bundles must remain cone-feasible. Signed compensation is necessary; positive feature parts are not monotone resource reports. Continuous embeddings do not automatically supply finite efficient algorithms. Total-output factors do not imply gain-only funding.
tracks.status: recorded theorem family; application conditional
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof, scoped exact checks, original-source comparison
tracks.remaining_work: Specialist priority and one economically specified owner/withdrawal/sponsor contract; no measured pooling claim.

tracks.title: PSD minimum-eigenvalue production
tracks.exact_claim: For PSD_m minimum-eigenvalue production the inverse rule gives full OUT with total mF; diagonal restriction yields lower 1+c(m-1). A fixed-owner rank-weighted gain rule and singular-domain coalition result are recorded.
tracks.limits: Fixed masks, spectral Huber, fixed regular shapes, resolvent mixtures and fixed-subspace compression have scoped obstructions. None alone proves those rates necessary for arbitrary mechanisms. Matrix order differs from ambient entry dimension.
tracks.status: parked structural branch
tracks.evidence_class: analytic arguments and exact diagnostic obstructions
tracks.remaining_work: Need an adaptive owner-sensitive construction with a proved consequence, or a truly unrestricted lower.

tracks.title: Gains-only funding and pair protection
tracks.exact_claim: Individual OUT gain funding S+KG has dimension/owner upper bounds including refined coefficient K_D~sqrt(8D/pi). For min2 with n fully eligible fixed owners, singleton/pair full OUT has (n-4)/22<=K_n<=n/2 for n>=5; three-owner coefficient 5/4 is sharp.
tracks.limits: Pair payment-only TCWM remains open. The four-owner 9/7 result is a lower only. Total funding and gains-only funding cannot be interchanged; zero-gain completion can defeat finite gain-only coefficients under stronger coalition contracts.
tracks.status: parked open question with proved boundaries
tracks.evidence_class: analytic translation/symmetry reductions and exact finite certificates
tracks.remaining_work: Nonlinear/nonseparable owner-specific construction satisfying residual 0-to-1 pair sensitivity; do not repeat blocked common-positive sampling or separable projection.

tracks.title: One common resource and private substitutes
tracks.exact_claim: Sharp 3/2 TCWM with one common resource and an unbounded private diminishing-returns block, for the stated continuous monotone concave homogeneous technology zero on both block axes. Public polymatroids admit explicit rational price/evaluation tools; coverage ranks have a max-flow implementation.
tracks.limits: General nonsmooth rule uses compactness; generic SFM backend is exponential. Fixed fleet mix is not freely variable GPU/memory/power. Two common heterogeneous resources remain open; three-block averaging and logarithmic OUT completion have exact mixed-owner failures.
tracks.status: one-common theorem retained; two-common extension stopped
tracks.evidence_class: analytic proof, algorithmic reductions, exact implementation checks
tracks.remaining_work: Joint compensation invariant surviving mixed ownership of both commons; another bounded example does not clear the gate.

tracks.title: 20 October unrestricted upper-bound gate
tracks.exact_claim: No improvement to sqrt(s/6)<=K3(s)<=K3^OUT(s)<=3s^2. Balanced comparison-only two-terminal components contract without extra budget; k varying owners give max(k,r) finite-component bound. Terminal-budget finite certificates admit budget-adapted feasible price selections after local null erasure.
tracks.limits: One-layer means disjoint all-tail/all-head sets. Efficient prices at every profile are obstructed by exact optimum 285/278; negative-defect mass 2/139. Relaxed price selection is not a bounded-price primal mechanism and is not proved for all optimal duals. More sources/sinks and outgoing reserve obligations remain.
tracks.status: 90-minute gate completed; continuation criterion not met
tracks.evidence_class: conventional proof plus exact rational replay and scoped independent audit
tracks.remaining_work: New uniform charging or reserve inequality with a demonstrable bound improvement; later reset/selection/compensation obstructions must be read first.

tracks.title: Baseline-preserving truthful repair candidate
tracks.exact_claim: 24 October consolidated candidate: every efficient-core selector has envelope >=(N+6)/8 on the pool family; every fixed baseline budget B<2 has a linear sequence; every fixed cap C>=1 and fixed power r>1 minimum-norm cover seed has true-envelope Theta_C(N) order along a sequence (C=2 lower (N-1)/11). Uncapped quadratic envelope exceeds (1/40)sqrt(N)(log N/log log N)^(1/3).
tracks.limits: Growing lower bounds require baseline domination and do not lower-bound every mechanism. An immediate separate unrestricted factor-two lower follows from the B<2 result via q=M, E[M]=M. Fixed C/r cannot vary with N; resource dimension grows. No PDF export for the final candidate was recorded.
tracks.status: consolidated review draft; distinct possible design-boundary paper
tracks.evidence_class: complete conventional proofs, ten exact diagnostics, internal cross-model review
tracks.remaining_work: Human review of all-cut transport, simultaneous report realization and cap/KKT argument; Uhan full-text, Arin final-version and wider withholding comparisons. The old universal sqrt(N) target for this envelope is closed.

tracks.title: 24 October graph construction and tree stopping gate
tracks.exact_claim: Full OUT with total factor 1+1/sqrt(2) on unit-profit path P4, complete blow-ups, disjoint unions and isolates for arbitrary mixed owners and all reports; integrated into P9. Fixed leaf-layer reserve recursion fails on the path P6 for every 0<alpha<1 and 0<=beta<1.
tracks.limits: Neither arbitrary-graph upper nor optimality on the four-resource path. Failure concerns original leaves before newly exposed vertices; arbitrary sequential orders, beta=1, adaptive reserves and all tree mechanisms are not excluded. Output-maximizing capacity splits also fail mixed-owner incentives.
tracks.status: positive theorem integrated; bounded tree extension stopped
tracks.evidence_class: analytic all-cell/boundary proof; 625 exact algebraic profiles; recursion witness plus nine rational cases
tracks.remaining_work: Joint boundary flow/payment invariant; specialist check of mixed-owner restoration and complete-group transfer. Current PDFs are in 25 October specialist packet.

tracks.title: AI serving, answer qualification and energy history
tracks.exact_claim: Public A100/H100 conditional scheduling replay: 71/92 pooled vs 69/92 separate on-time completions, below the five-point gate. Mac pilot 64/64 vs 59/64 within five seconds failed its improvement threshold. Mixed study: 1053 actual requests, 183 completions, zero quality passes, 870 timeouts. Later serial/grounded/claim/checker screens were negative qualifications; deterministic proof-backed fallback and exact retrieval became engineering tools.
tracks.limits: Conditional schedule replay is not deployed pooling. Mac component estimates are not wall energy; user described M3 Pro but recorded inventory says M3 Max, so use verified host records. Do not delete failed/unrun windows, retune gates or equate completed requests with useful output.
tracks.status: engineering evidence retained; no demonstrated pooling or energy gain
tracks.evidence_class: measured local requests, protocol failures, raw recounts and synthetic tests
tracks.remaining_work: Real accepted-output quality, arrival validity and compatible full-horizon energy precede pooling. All older runs remain sealed; use each frozen protocol for exact denominators.

tracks.limits: Only a Mac was available; synthetic fixtures are not operator data, concurrent GPU serving or evidence of real owners. Opportunity costs and private reports require separate contracts.

tracks.remaining_work: Compatible owner/withdrawal/scheduler data or operator-run collection; no partner or server access may be inferred.

tracks.title: Shared power reserve and M100 feasibility
tracks.exact_claim: May compatibility record: 3,659,699 paired PSU observations, 980 nodes; 1,942/4,320 nominal instants complete. Subsequent metadata gate: June full-chunk plan requires 107,625,469 new bytes vs 6,393,615 remaining; inspected chunks each declare one data page. No suitable historical measurement/state contract established.
tracks.limits: April and May are exposed calibration. June candidate was not selected/evaluated holdout. Scheduler state is not physical power-off. The reader-specific byte stop is not a universal impossibility. Telemetry does not establish rights, workload identity, withdrawals or sponsor surplus.
tracks.status: stopped feasibility; conditional reserve model retained
tracks.evidence_class: observed telemetry compatibility; metadata audit; no new outcome panel
tracks.remaining_work: Operator-grade physical semantics and rights plus predeclared held-out reliability/net-value evaluation. Increasing download cap alone cannot fix it.

tracks.title: Latest Mac retrieval and arrival qualification
tracks.exact_claim: 24 October retrieval: 3200 measured answers and 320 warmups reconcile correctly, but all 16 windows fail 2 ms p99 arrival-jitter gate; 56 deadline misses in three bounded windows; no rate selected. Synthetic thread/process follow-up observed only 100/2400 requests; p99 5.951299 and 5.083630 ms both fail. Runner exceeded internal deadline and was externally terminated.
tracks.limits: Tests passing did not establish dependable cleanup. Shared-event cleanup is a plausible unconfirmed cause. Missing 2300 planned requests remain missing; no comparative performance, causal GIL, serving/energy or pooling conclusion follows.
tracks.status: failed and sealed; external termination prerequisite
tracks.evidence_class: raw measured timing, exact independent recount, incomplete-run audit
tracks.remaining_work: External supervisor with bounded process cleanup and fault-injection checks before any fresh physical measurement; preserve all partial evidence.

Finite {1,2,3,4}^{4x7} box has retained checked lower-count certificate. General A1 physical repair/admission remains open. Separate shared-three-value three-agent chores manuscript claims m<=11.

Historical 4x8 Lean/SMT hybrid scope is covered by later up-to-nine-good theorem. Chores portability differs by rung; full eleven-chore result is not all Lean. This pass did not refresh the EFX owner session.

tracks.remaining_work: Coordinator should reconcile with current EFX owner. Need physical repair or complete-exit proof for A1; retained portable certification for distinct chores rung; no general additive EFX claim.

tracks.limits: Universal selector existence remains open. Common-grand theorem covers 20 specified orbits; only five unequal-grand orbits were recorded completed. Proper-coalition nested-core argument does not cover changing grand worth; translation handles the single aggregate edge separately.

tracks.title: Joint investment and accepted AI output (neighbors)
tracks.exact_claim: Integral strict-chain investment: welfare-optimal activation admits an original gross-core allocation paying every entrant its public cost, under ex ante enforceable transfers/no incumbent veto. Separately Accepted Output models cost per accepted result including verification and human fallback, with held-out-information routing.
tracks.limits: Investment is a classical flow-duality deduction under a strong contract, not universal financing sufficiency. Accepted Output uses selected historical METR data and modeled fallback, not workplace causal effects or current-model forecasts. These are separate publication units.
tracks.status: related economics; use for interpretation, not new CoopGPT theorem count
